description:
From the fz-kdt.178 cold review (2026-09-03). Two instrument gaps, one
ticket because both are about NAMING what the instruments see.
(1) surface_membership::observe reports value + element + predicate but not
WHICH plan admitted the value (call-edge callsite, executable entry dispatch,
or construction wrapper w<N> selection). That is how "w2" was attributed to
00277's escape for two tickets and one commit without ever being measured
(the escaping wrappers are w10, w11, w13-w20). The interpreter's type_match
knows the plan it is executing (select_dispatch_body / the wrapper selection
call site); thread a PlanSite label into observe so the report reads
`wrapper w13 selection: value [1, :tail], element 1 = :tail ...`.
(2) seated_arm_surfaces returns an empty read (whole plan skipped, silently)
on the first non-Region::Type question. On the corpus that is 335 of 406
entry plans: Region::List 498 occurrences, Equal 137, Guard 83, TupleArity
72, MapKind/MapKeyPresent/Bitstring 3/3/2. A Guard genuinely cannot be read
statically; a Region::List (shape) or TupleArity question CAN -- it is a
predicate over the value like Region::Type. Read the readable variants and
print the skipped-plan count and reason so the entry class's zero is honest.
Sequence: after fz-kdt.178 (which prints the skipped count), before 179's
acceptance (which wants the dynamic report to name the wrapper it cured).
title: The dynamic tripwire prints no plan site and the static census silently skips 82.5% of entry plans: name the wrapper/callsite in the escape report and read Region::List questions
